summary: Copies an input 4-DWORD plus double structure, normalizes the 3-vector formed by the doubles at offsets 0x0, 0x8 and 0x10, selects a perpendicular construction path based on a fabs(x) >= 0.7 threshold, builds two orthonormal basis vectors (the second as a cross product) and normalizes both outputs. Used for constraint-axis construction; called by BufferEntryAppendWithMatrixInit.

operations.description: If output pointer a2 is null, substitute a stack temporary
If output basis-vector pointer a3 is null, substitute a stack temporary
If output basis-vector pointer a4 is null, substitute a stack temporary
Copy four DWORDs from input a1 (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) into a2 and the double at a1+0x10 into a2+0x10
Normalize the 3-vector read as doubles from a2 (components at offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x10): divide each component by sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)

Choose the perpendicular construction branch: if fabs(x) >= 0.7 (the dbl_59E830 threshold) build (-z, 0, x), else build (0, z, -y); the 1.0 and 0.0 selection constants match the read-only globals dbl_59E420 (1.0) and dbl_59E430 (0.0) listed by deterministic facts, though the raw body inlines them as literals
Build the first basis vector in a3 (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8) from the chosen perpendicular combination of the normalized components
Build the second basis vector in a4 (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8) as the cross product of the first basis vector and the normalized input vector
